purpose: ユーザー依頼の非公開接続。Maker Field JSONから1件のMarkdown下書きを手動で渡す。

adaptation.kind: Independent browser adaptation; not an unchanged vendor copy
changes: Separated read-only JSON validation and conversion from Node CLI, VM and filesystem writing
No Maker Field localStorage, history, subscription or global store code copied
Added duplicate JSON key rejection, including escaped equivalent keys, before JSON.parse
Retained structure, character, record, image and UTF-8 byte limits
Replaced Node hashing and buffers with WebCrypto, TextEncoder and Uint8Array
Reused the site's existing draft exporter; output remains one note with draft: true

sources.scope: Input character checks, field mapping, literal fences, report and output limits
Data structure, field, date, image and record validation rules only
Local one-record Markdown handoff contract and source attribution

verification: Source files and existing site module bytes were SHA-256 hashed read-only; original source was not executed or modified.

license.note: 参照したアダプター配下にLICENSE/NOTICEは確認できなかった。新ライセンス付与なし。出典記録は再配布許諾を表すものではない。ユーザー依頼の非公開接続として独立実装した。

portableExtension.scope: User-requested private portability comparison: one selected draft, up to two original raster image byte arrays, and a conversion report in a STORE ZIP.
portableExtension.implementation: New local code in portable.mjs and stored-zip.mjs; optional image handoff in the independent adapter. The default Markdown conversion and historical source hashes above remain unchanged.
portableExtension.validation: Declared PNG/JPEG/WebP signature and browser decoding before download; original image bytes retained; relative ASCII paths; bounded archive; no automatic inclusion of unselected records or original JSON.
portableExtension.license: Existing source attribution and absence of a supplied LICENSE remain unchanged. No new license or redistribution permission is inferred.
